summary.text: Nick Taylor is the Libertarian candidate for North Carolina House of Representatives District 25 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Allen Chesser II (R) and Democrat Lorenza M. Wilkins. He is a high school teacher.

paragraphs.text: Taylor ran unsuccessfully for the state House in 2018, 2020, 2022 and 2024.
Ballotpedia quotes his campaign Facebook page as describing him as a Nash County native running for North Carolina House District 25.
